sn17.24:1.4: Also at [an2.133]() and [an4.176:4.2](). | Khujjuttarā was the most learned of the laywomen ([an1.260]()). | Veḷukaṇṭakī features as a meditator, reciter, and donor at [an6.37]() and [an7.53](). She is probably the same person as Uttarā Nanda’s mother who was the foremost laywoman jhana practitioner ([an1.262]()).
